candidate: W7 / selective thin-filament calcium desensitization in TNNT2 p.R94C restrictive cardiomyopathy
novelty: Deepened existing candidate; not new unique hit
decision_exact_article: Deprioritize systemic development; mechanistic reference only with off-target controls
decision_target: Retain selective thin-filament desensitization as a discovery reserve
decision_change: Specific direct electrophysiology liabilities strengthen exact-article deprioritization beyond generic calmodulin concerns

evidence.assay: HEK293 whole-cell patch clamp, 22–23 C, protein-free Tyrode-type bath
evidence.interpretation: Direct channel blockade; no clinical arrhythmia rate or established clinical margin inferred

evidence.outcome: Improved diastolic measures with lower relative systolic penalty than mavacamten in this background
evidence.access: Indexed primary main text and legend; figure image and publisher PDF unavailable

evidence.interpretation: Acute/ex-vivo mechanistic support plus reduced normal systolic contraction; not chronic systemic safety

evidence.assay: Rabbit coronary arterial smooth-muscle Kv current
evidence.interpretation: Additional direct vascular current liability, not a quantified human clinical outcome
